---

import * as C from "@constants";

{C.TIMESCALE_DB} natively includes some {C.JOB}-scheduling policies, such as:

- [{C.CAGG_CAP} policies](/build/continuous-aggregates/refresh-policies) to automatically refresh {C.CAGG}s
- [{C.HYPERCORE_CAP} policies](/learn/columnar-storage) to optimize and compress historical data
- [Retention policies](/build/data-management/data-retention/create-a-retention-policy) to drop historical data
- [Reordering policies](/reference/timescaledb/hypertables/add_reorder_policy) to reorder data within {C.CHUNK}s

If these don't cover your use case, you can create and schedule custom-defined {C.JOB}s to run within
your database. They help you automate periodic tasks that aren't covered by the native policies.

In this section, you see how to:

- [Create and manage {C.JOB}s](/build/data-management/jobs/create-and-manage-jobs)
- Set up a [generic data retention](/build/data-management/jobs/example-generic-retention) policy that applies across all {C.HYPERTABLE}s
- Implement [automatic moving of {C.CHUNK}s between tablespaces](/build/data-management/jobs/example-tiered-storage)
- Automatically [downsample and compress](/build/data-management/jobs/example-downsample-and-compress) older {C.CHUNK}s
